input:
We’ve had a recurring issue where payment detail checking isn’t possible before sending out funds, which leads to bounced payments and delays in reissuing them
The platform does not allow users to verify payment details before sending funds, causing bounced payments and reissuance delays.

I’m having trouble uploading the policyholder documents for claim A13 — they keep failing validation.
The user is unable to upload policyholder documents for a specific claim because the system repeatedly fails validation.

can your system pull in supplier data without breaking our existing reporting?
The customer is concerned that integrating supplier portal data into the Keelwater system might disrupt their existing reporting workflows.

the permissions system is causing delays — it’s tedious and error-prone.
The permissions system is difficult to use and prone to errors, causing delays when setting up new teams.

We’ve been trying to automate those letters and hit a wall with the current defaults.
The current default settings for letter automation are insufficient, preventing the customer from automating their letters.

Can you walk me through how to attach documents to a claim? I keep missing a step.
The user finds the process for attaching documents to a claim confusing and difficult to follow.

when we generate letters for policies with two named holders, the system only pulls through one name, sometimes the wrong one.
The system fails to include both names when generating letters for policies with two named holders, often selecting the wrong one.

I’ve got a recurring issue with joint policyholder letters — they’re only pulling through one name, and it’s causing complaints.
The system fails to include all joint policyholder names in generated letters, resulting in only one name appearing.

we’re trying to streamline our claims handling and need help filtering tasks by due date.
The customer needs a feature to filter tasks by due date to streamline claims handling.

can we export our case notes as PDFs? It’s for audit purposes. We need to be able to export notes as PDF for compliance and internal review — it’s not just convenience, it’s required for our monthly audits.
The platform currently lacks the ability to export case notes as PDF files, which is required for compliance and monthly audits.

That’s a workaround, but we’re handling 200+ claims a week—manual edits aren’t scalable.
The current workaround for fixing letter merge fields requires manual edits, which is not scalable for high-volume claim processing.

the system isn’t handling joint policyholder names correctly — it’s pulling in just one, and that’s triggering formal complaints.
The system fails to correctly process joint policyholder names, retrieving only one name and causing formal complaints.

Claim details: click "Save", rage x3
The user is frustrated because saving claim details requires multiple attempts or behaves unexpectedly.

we’ve had three complaints this month just because the joint policyholder names weren’t merged correctly.
The system fails to correctly merge joint policyholder names, leading to complaints.

We’re seeing delays because payee account verification isn’t done before payment dispatch.
Payments are delayed because the system does not verify payee accounts before dispatching them.

Reports: click "Save", rage x3
The user is frustrated because the 'Save' action in Reports does not work as expected.

we can’t verify bank details ahead of time, which causes bounces.
The platform does not allow users to verify third-party bank details before processing payments, leading to failed transactions.

We’re seeing a problem where letters sent to joint policyholders merge only one name — this synonym ‘multiple names on letters’ is critical because clients are complaining and it’s hurting our reputation.
Letters sent to joint policyholders incorrectly merge only one name instead of including all names.

the reporting module doesn’t always sync the latest tasks with our policyholders’ records. Is there a known fix or workaround?
The reporting module fails to consistently synchronize the latest task updates with policyholder records.

We’re stuck because we can’t copy access roles — every new handler needs permissions ticked individually, and if we slip up, they’re locked out of their tasks.
The platform lacks a feature to copy or duplicate access roles, forcing manual configuration for each new user which is error-prone and time-consuming.

If I could copy an existing role, it’d save hours every week. It’s frustrating that I can’t just duplicate an existing role — I have to manually select permissions for each new user...
Users cannot duplicate existing roles, forcing them to manually configure permissions for each new user, which is time-consuming and error-prone.

our policyholders are starting to notice the delays.
The platform is experiencing delays that are becoming noticeable to end-users.

the payee account verification step isn’t happening before the payment is sent out, which causes rework and client frustration.
The system sends payments before verifying the payee account, leading to delays and rework.

We’re manually editing the letters before sending, but it’s time-consuming and prone to error with joint policyholder names.
The platform does not correctly handle joint policyholder names in generated letters, forcing users to manually edit them which is slow and error-prone.

The permission setup duplication is a real bottleneck — every new user means manually selecting permissions, and one slip can lock someone out of their claims tasks.
The current permission setup process is inefficient and error-prone, requiring manual configuration for each new user which risks locking them out of tasks.
